project: Project Sagar — 2D Fighting Game Animation Production

animations.name: Idle Breathing
animations.gameplay_purpose: Default neutral combat stance breathing and rhythmic bounce loop
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); feet stay anchored on ground_y across all 8 frames.

animations.name: Forward Walking
animations.gameplay_purpose: Advancing toward opponent while maintaining combat guard
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); planted foot aligns to ground_y on every frame.

animations.name: Backward Walking
animations.gameplay_purpose: Defensive retreat while facing opponent with guard raised
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); planted foot aligns to ground_y.

animations.name: Forward Dash
animations.gameplay_purpose: High-speed burst forward to close distance or initiate pressure
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); planted push-off/braking feet anchor to ground_y.

animations.name: Backward Dash
animations.gameplay_purpose: Evasive backstep hop to escape pressure or bait whiffs
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Ground reference at (144, 272); Frame 3 preserves natural airborne backstep elevation above ground_y.

animations.name: Crouch Transition
animations.gameplay_purpose: Rapid transition from standing stance into low crouch
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); feet remain planted as torso lowers.

animations.name: Crouch Idle
animations.gameplay_purpose: Low-profile crouching breathing loop ready for low attacks or blocks
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); bare feet and rear knee stay anchored low.

animations.name: Return to Standing
animations.gameplay_purpose: Smooth recovery rising from crouch back into standing guard
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); matches standing idle stance on Frame 2.

animations.name: Jump Take-Off
animations.gameplay_purpose: Pre-jump crouch anticipation (Frame 1) and explosive upward launch (Frame 2)
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Ground reference at (144, 272); Frame 1 planted on ground_y, Frame 2 launching upward.

animations.name: Jumping / Airborne Loop
animations.gameplay_purpose: Mid-air ascent, apex tuck, and descent states for vertical/angled jumps
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Center-balanced airborne pivot within 288x288 cell; engine drives Y-trajectory while frames cycle ascent/apex/descent.

animations.name: Landing
animations.gameplay_purpose: Landing impact squash absorption (Frame 1) and recovery to fighting guard (Frame 2)
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); both bare feet firmly planted on ground_y.
